label: Gerardus Johannes Emanuel Rutten, A…: Strict proper-part descent on the fixed non-null object…
locator: 2012 dissertation, chapter VII, printed p.155 through p.156, objection that the second premise is insufficient for Step1 and adjusted second-premise reply
interpretation: The author distinguishes original P2 mereological atomism from the absence of infinite descending proper-part sequences. He raises the atomistic interval/subset model objection, disputes its independent ontological significance, but grants that IF such a model is admitted then original Step1 does not follow from atomism alone. He then explicitly adjusts P2 to prohibit downward infinite proper-part sequences, claiming that the earlier defense already supports it; footnote209 adds a science-based defense. Render that adjusted termination premise by the existing standard WellFounded strict parthood on the supplied non-null object domain, with its classical order interpretation explicit. This is not a new statement, a proof that atomicity entails well-foundedness, an independently verified defense of the premise, causal well-foundedness, a prohibition of infinite causal chains, or a modal-necessity/God conclusion. The entire pinned ChapterVII reply range154–158/PDF156–160 was materialized and read, including the distinct Step5 and total-cause replies.
